context.title: California Common Cause: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: California — Proposition 4 (Repeals Prohibition Against Public Funding of Election Campaigns)

positions.statement: Darius Kemp (Executive Director) signed the rebuttal to the argument against Proposition 4 in the official voter guide.

subject.title: California — Proposition 5 (Changes Recall Election Process for Statewide Officers)

positions.statement: Darius L. Kemp (MPA, Executive Director) signed the argument in favor of Proposition 5 and the rebuttal to the argument against Proposition 5 in the official voter guide.

subject.title: California — Proposition 39 (Prohibits Citizens from Voting Unless They Present Government-Issued Identification)

positions.statement: Darius Kemp (California State Director) signed the argument against Proposition 39 in the official voter guide.
